title: feat: add tiered storage via TimescaleDB
body:
Adds tiered storage using TimescaleDB: chain tables are partitioned by block number into hot segments (plain heap, full index set) and highly compressed cold segments (columnstore, 5.35x smaller on benched data), with a maintenance loop moving fully-synced segments behind the hot window into the cold tier. Everything remains one Postgres query surface, and the shipped Docker stacks enable it by default.

```
                                              ┌─────────────────────┐
                                              │      /query         │
                                              │                     │
                                              │  ?signature=...     │
                                              │  ?engine=...        │
                                              └──────────┬──────────┘
                                                         │
                       ┌─────────────────────────────────┴────┐
                       ▼                                      ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   ┌─────────────────────┐
│     PostgreSQL · TimescaleDB (OLTP)          │   │     ClickHouse      │
│                                              │   │      (OLAP)         │
│  blocks/txs/logs/receipts = hypertables      │   │                     │
│  chunked by block number                     │   └─────────┬───────────┘
│                                              │             │
│  block_num →                          tip    │             │
│  ┌────────┐┌────────┐     ┌────────┐┌──────┐ │             │
│  │ COLUMN ││ COLUMN │  …  │  ROW   ││ ROW  │ │             │
│  │ STORE  ││ STORE  │     │ STORE  ││STORE │ │             │
│  └────────┘└────────┘     └────────┘└──────┘ │             │
│  cold: compressed 4–7×    hot: plain heap    │             │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘             │
                       │                                     │
                       └──────────────────┬──────────────────┘
                                          │
                                  ┌───────┴───────┐
                                  │  Dual Sink    │
                                  └───────┬───────┘
                                          │
                                  ┌───────┴───────┐
                                  │  Sync Engine  │
                                  └───────────────┘
```
